title: Should Cost Modelling — Guidance Note
scope: Selected parsed sections 1, 2, 5 and 6; scope, whole-life boundaries and model-development stages. Not every figure or legal provision reviewed.
role: Model purpose, scope and lifecycle; UK public-procurement context, not an industrial certification.
note: The guide describes estimates under stated circumstances and periods, and a staged development approach. Senoni adapts that discipline to component review; it does not import procurement thresholds or claim government endorsement.

title: SCM Technical Build Guidance
scope: Selected technical guidance on inputs, assumptions, workbook structure, units and checks; not its entire spreadsheet implementation.
role: Traceable inputs, separable calculations and quality checks.
note: Our Python/JavaScript functions, schemas, test data and generators are original reference implementations, not a transcription of the government templates.

title: Cost Estimating and Assessment Guide: Best Practices for Developing and Managing Program Costs
scope: Official product overview and Highlights, especially the stated estimating steps; not the full 476-page report.
role: Technical baseline, assumptions, sensitivity, documentation and updates using actual costs.
note: Use the overview only for these high-level principles. Do not claim the full guide has been read, implement an uninspected appendix, or import public-sector decision rules into a private contract.

title: Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing, Working Paper 04-045
date: November 2003 in paper; copyright 2004 on cover
scope: Abstract and selected capacity-cost / unit-time sections, PDF pages 7–10, with capacity tables visually checked; no source examples or code reproduced.
role: Separate resource capacity supplied, activity time and unused capacity.
note: Capacity percentages and the source case amounts are examples, not our defaults. Our single-stage molding example is not a full TDABC implementation. The PDF metadata title is misleading; the cover identifies this work.

title: Target costing and life-cycle costing
scope: Article text on target costing, lifecycle scope and margin/markup; original exercise amounts not reused.
role: Separate market-facing targets from estimates and include relevant lifecycle consequences.
note: We credit Garrett’s explanation; we do not claim he or Senoni invented target or lifecycle costing. Our arithmetic examples and controls are separately specified.

title: Understanding Injection Mold Cost for Parts and Tooling
scope: Qualitative manufacturer guidance about geometry, material, mold complexity and volume; no process-capability tables or rates adopted.
role: Explain why a drawing alone does not supply all production and quotation assumptions.
note: Vendor guidance, not an independent performance study or transferable price database. No source design images are redistributed.

title: Open-book accounting in networks: Potential achievements and reasons for failures
scope: Institutional abstract and bibliographic record only; full empirical methods and six failure reasons not inspected.
role: Reminder that cost transparency has enabling conditions and failure modes.
note: The detailed supplier-dialogue and confidentiality rules here are Senoni design choices, not a reconstructed six-factor model attributed to these authors.

title: Rules
scope: Project .mdc rules, frontmatter, file references and AGENTS.md sections.
note: Referenced files are not automatically inlined; the agent must read them. Instruction loading is not a security boundary or evidence of compliant behavior.

title: Rules
scope: AGENTS.md, custom instructions and explicit selective file reading.
note: Use one entry route; preserve existing instructions. No remote auto-updating rules are installed.

title: Rules
scope: Supported rule types and workspace rule directories, including AGENTS.md.
note: Live-host behavior is not tested in this release; check installed versions and Rules panel.

title: Platform - Globality
scope: Vendor product page: intake routing, RFx creation, planning, supplier discovery, response collection, negotiation, scenario analysis, award recommendation, autonomous and collaborative modes, governance claims.
role: Evidence that intake routing, event creation and award-scenario recommendation are widely described platform capabilities; motivates the incremental-value framing.
note: Vendor-reported; efficiency and satisfaction figures on the page are not accepted as evidence. No product was used, tested or endorsed; the pack describes none of its internals.

title: Globality | Integration
scope: Vendor integration page: prebuilt connectors, APIs, webhooks, project creation from a guided-buying intake, requisition creation or update through middleware.
role: Illustrates that a procurement platform typically keeps the customer's procurement system authoritative for requisitions and contracts and exchanges records through connectors.
note: Vendor-reported; no connector is implemented, described or recommended by this pack.

title: Autonomous and Automatic Sourcing Software - Keelvar
scope: Vendor product page: automated sourcing-event creation from requests, bidder invitation, bid collection, award recommendation with human review.
role: Evidence that automated event creation and award recommendation with human checkpoints are described capabilities.
note: Vendor-reported; outcome figures not accepted as evidence; no product used or endorsed.

title: Direct Materials Sourcing for Buyers - Keelvar
scope: Vendor product page: direct-materials sourcing, award scenarios with capacity, bundle and supplier-count constraints, cost-breakdown collection.
role: Evidence that constrained award scenarios (capacity, bundles, concentration) are a recognized problem; motivates the allocation-feasibility check.
note: Vendor-reported; the pack's feasibility check is a tiny exhaustive illustration, not a reimplementation of any optimizer.

title: AI-Native Autonomous Sourcing Software for Procurement | Procol
scope: Vendor product page: autonomous sourcing from request to recommendation, quote comparison, approval routing, audit trail.
role: Evidence that quote comparison with approval routing and audit trail is a described capability.
note: Vendor-reported; no product used or endorsed; no metric accepted as evidence.

title: Procurement Orchestration Platform | Procol
scope: Vendor product page: intake, routing and workflow orchestration across procurement systems.
role: Evidence that intake routing across existing systems is a recognized orchestration need.
note: Vendor-reported; the pack's five-route rule set is Senoni's own design.

title: Autonomous Indirect Procurement | Pactum
scope: Vendor product page: agents operating inside an existing procure-to-pay flow, rulebook checks, observe-advise-act progression, human review.
role: Evidence that rule-checked recommendations inside an existing P2P flow with graduated autonomy are described capabilities; informs the bounded-action table.
note: Vendor-reported; page title differs from its URL slug and is recorded as displayed on inspection; no product used or endorsed.

title: Alignment Agent | Pactum
scope: Vendor product page: automated supplier negotiation within configured parameters and reported outcome figures.
role: Evidence that bounded automated negotiation is a described capability; the pack specifies permission separation and enables none of it.
note: Vendor-reported; outcome figures not accepted as evidence; no negotiation agent is implemented or recommended.
